svg.title: BTNL3 plus BTNL8 coexpression, distinct proteins
svg.desc: BTNL3 supplies the mapped Vγ4-interacting surface. The coexpressed pair is a minimal building block, not a full oligomeric structure. Native editable vector; domain cartoons are not atomic models.

g.text: Partner proteins, not alleles of one
